runtime.execution: Synchronous client wrappers run asyncio chunk worker pool; separate serial embedding calls and diskcache object/value cache.

summary: literature PDF/text summaries, embeddings and a keyed local publication cache

inspection.scope: LocalDatabase CRUD/class restore, LongText cache/summarization and OpenaiLongParser chunk/dispatch/retry/abort/save paths; selected literal database/chunk and live-API cache tests
inspection.limits: No acquired module was imported because source has import-time network setup; no test/model/API calls ran. No autonomous coding-agent loop is supplied.

actions.name: LocalDatabase.save_to_database/load_from_database/reset_key/get_list_keys
actions.input: Caller keys/values and optional database path
actions.output: Stored value, key list or deletion
actions.lifecycle: Named diskcache path persists; default temp lifetime documented; destructor closes connection
actions.authority: Calling Python client; no model SQL dispatcher or external governor

actions.name: save_class_to_database / load_class_from_database
actions.lifecycle: Mutable keyed snapshots overwrite; guard checks outer key instead of dict_key for intended database-pointer skip
actions.authority: Library caller can restore all saved fields; no original audit guarantees

actions.name: LongText.summarize_longtext_into_chunks(...)
actions.input: Text/chunk size and desired final chunk count, optional output path/concurrency
actions.output: Model-derived cached summary and optional text file
actions.lifecycle: Repeated reduction/cleanup calls until target, no reduction-round budget; cached summary reused irrespective of later target
actions.authority: Library caller; paid provider uses fixed authored prompt

actions.name: OpenaiLongParser.multi_call_chatGPT / async_call_chatGPT
actions.input: Prompt list/temperature/penalties; timeout/retries on async API
actions.output: Texts ordered by input slot or exception
actions.lifecycle: Bounded workers and per-attempt timeout; common abort cancels workers without await; no remote job handle/quiescence guarantee
actions.authority: Caller uses externally configured OpenAI authority; fixed chat model

actions.name: process_chunks_through_prompt(prompt, save_path=...)
actions.output: Per-chunk texts; optional assembled input/result text files
actions.lifecycle: Concurrent map then saves outputs; numbered files can overwrite; no complete attempts/raw-provider log

actions.name: call_embeddingGPT / process_chunks_through_embedding
actions.lifecycle: Serial provider requests; paper fields cached after calculation

evidence.claim: Experimental publication API scripts, not agent product.
Diskcache lifecycle, dictionary/class snapshots, keys/load/reset; restore guard compares outer key rather than field key.
LongText cache key is text hash plus chunk-size hash, or caller key; restores object fields and saves snapshots.
Repeated model summarization until chunk target, optional cleanup/save, cached summary bypasses changed target; no maximum reduction rounds.
Sentence-boundary tokenization/chunks, detokenized source copies; literature transformation, not managed agent compaction.
Async queued workers with fixed gpt-3.5 model, per-attempt increasing wait_for timeout, retry/abort on failure.
Failure branches fall through to response processing; success ordering by input slots; shared abort, worker.cancel without await, polling private semaphore value.
Sync asyncio.run wrapper and fixed Ada embedding endpoint.
Optional input_chunk/output_chunk text files preserve assembled prompts/text results, not raw provider IO/attempt history.
Embedding chunks are submitted serially and return vectors/chunks.
Paper fields, wall update timestamp and cache restoration.
Field embedding reuse/cache and Crossref metadata request.
Literal saved data, class-field restore, reset and list-key oracles.
Module demands API credential; chunk tests use expected literals, live generation expects fixed strings; no failure/cancellation oracle here.
Live-model cache tests compare persisted fields with same run output, not scientific truth or backend call suppression.

tests.oracle: Literal saved longtext, overwritten target attribute, deletion and key-list assertions; no durable restart or pointer-identity oracle inspected.

tests.focus: Chunk boundaries and live model calls
tests.oracle: Expected literal sentence groups and exact generated text; imports require credentials. No offline failure/timeout/cancellation fault oracle in this file.
Same-run generated field equals stored field; does not assert provider call count/parameter invalidation or scientific correctness.

strengths: Straightforward keyed persistent publication cache and programmatic retrieval.
Chunk/CRUD expected literals attack concrete parsing/storage faults.
limits: Cache identity omits final summary target and model/prompt version; restoring class uses wrong variable in intended database-pointer skip.
Failure handling falls through into response processing and repeated queue acknowledgments; canceled workers are not awaited.
Summary reduction lacks progress/round bound; text/cache snapshots are not original audit.
arconaut_questions: Which result cache keys must include program/model/parameter versions so a durable cached result cannot masquerade as current computation?
How should mapped-provider tasks retain original attempts/failures and prove quiescence before refit?
